args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a blunt shield-bash hit impact at one point: a chunky four-to-six pointed impact star of white and pale amber light, around it two thick layered crescent shock ripples opening to the right (cream core, steel-blue rim), a handful of chunky orange-white sparks and tiny steel glints flying out, and a small shaded grey-brown dust puff below. Compact but richly rendered, a beginner skill: the effect fills about half of the canvas, not an explosion, no fire, no magic runes, no glowing barrier dome. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference image: solid parts (dust puffs, pebbles, metal glints) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color with a darker colored rim, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur, no thin single-pixel line art. Layered composition: one main shape, secondary layered shapes, and small scattered particles. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no creatures, no animals, no silhouettes, no weapons, no shields, no text, transparent background.
